dialect.detail: Converted from an older dialect via 'COBOL CONVERSION AID PO 5785-ABJ' (IBM product), targeting IBM mainframe environment. SYS0xx-FBA1 and SYS0xx-UT-2400 ASSIGN clauses are classic IBM OS/VS COBOL style. VMOD=2.024 versioning. Logic, Inc. Dallas TX product (insurance/claims system).
evidence: fixed 80-col format with sequence numbers in cols 1-6

purpose.domain_detail: Group insurance claims processing — monthly claim history extract tape creation for claims month-end reporting. Reads claim master, certificate master, account master, check queue, program options, letter archive, retrieve file, and convenience policy master; outputs a history archive file.
purpose.summary: EL309 is a monthly batch program that creates a claim history extract tape used as input to claims month-end reporting. It reads multiple indexed files (claim master, certificate master, activity trailers, etc.) and writes a history archive output file. It also updates the claim master file.

notable_features: COMP-3 group item for working-storage counters
Multiple INDEXED ORGANIZATION files with DYNAMIC access and FILE STATUS
COPY statements for all FD record layouts (ELCCNTL, ELCCERT, ELCMSTR, etc.)
COPY REPLACING for history output file FD
Sequence numbers in columns 1-6 (classic mainframe format)
'pemuni' comment indicator lines (non-standard comment marker in sequence area)
Year 2000 compliance review noted in header
Conversion from older COBOL dialect via IBM conversion aid
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 2273 lines. The 'pemuni' prefix on some lines (e.g., lines 167, 177, 181) appears to be a non-standard comment or conditional compilation marker used in the source management system rather than standard COBOL. COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown. The program is proprietary to Logic, Inc., Dallas TX.
